ranking_note: Authored from the description at base commit b3b38650f8, frozen before the concise rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. The plugin has one skill, so every competitor is in another plugin. Positives cover a fresh name for each listed modality (function, CLI command, file, repo, domain term, skill), a retry after a rejected name or shortlist, and one high-stakes public name (the tournament argument). Near-misses sit beside the rename-references sweep (a decided rename, stragglers after a git mv), the docs-naming file-name skills (a casing audit, applying a rename plan, emitting a file-name gate), glossary curation in domain-driven-design, a style-guide lookup the skill routes to the ecosystem's guide, and a regex for branch names. Positives paraphrase the description rather than repeat its quoted phrases.
